## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- Skyguide planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 393.6M€2022, of which 98.9% relates to new major investments. Skyguide planned 8 new major investments for RP4, of which 7 have started and 1 has not yet started.

- In 2025, Skyguide underspent -4.3M€2022 (-52.2%) in costs related to new major investments. This is mainly due to some delays.

- According to the reporting tables, Skyguide overspent +0.8M€2022 (+1.9%) in costs related to investments in 2025.

- Skyguide reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
